versions.changelog:
- Now requires explicit user approval before sending data to Vestafolio's external API; explains fields and asks for consent.
- Only sends simulator-relevant fields; excludes optional and unrelated data.
- Does not POST if the user declines; instead, offers the manual simulator link.
- Installing/selecting the skill alone is not considered user approval.

- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- No functional or behavioral changes; documentation file only.

- Initial public release: Computes French real-estate capital gains tax (impôt sur la plus-value immobilière) with all abatements, exemptions, and LMNP-specific cases using the Vestafolio simulator API.
- Guides users step-by-step in French to collect all required data before calculation.
- Covers standard sales, résidence principale exemption, secondary residences, and LMNP (with amortization reintegration).
- Explains holding-period abatements (22/30 years), deductions, and when waiting to sell may save tax.
- Only uses live simulator results—never substitutes worked examples or known rules for actual API calculations; fails gracefully if unavailable.
- Provides links to the interactive simulator for further exploration and official results.
